biggest_gap.title: The audit of numbering changes cannot be read on screen: a next-number change is missing from the sequence's history, the audit log names no numbering record, and 'Starts again' changes show raw codes
biggest_gap.detail: The scope says 'audit of changes'. The database records every change, but no screen lets a user answer 'who moved our purchase order numbers to 500, on which sequence?'. (1) Setting the next number writes numbering.counters, not numbering.sequences, so the sequence's History panel (Alt+Y) does not show it at all. (2) In the Audit log every numbering row reads Record '(empty)', so the user cannot tell which of the 44 sequences or which company changed. Example: 'Changed · Numbering counter · (empty) · Next number: from 148 to 500'. The cause: the audit capture takes record_label from name or code columns, and numbering's tables have none. Other modules (contacts, users, currencies, branches) are labelled. (3) The 'Starts again' column is stored as a smallint (0/1/2), but the audit choice labels are keyed audit.choice.numbering.sequences.reset.yearly/monthly/never. So History reads 'Restarts 1 -> 0' in English and 'إعادة البدء: من 1 إلى 0' in Arabic, and the creation entry shows the key 'sales.order' as the document. The field is also called 'Restarts' there but 'Starts again' on the form. Points 3 and the key were already reported last round and are unchanged. Odoo keeps no history for ir.sequence at all, so this does not lose the comparison, but it misses the piece's own scope and CLAUDE.md rule 4's 'who changed what'.
biggest_gap.evidence: To reproduce on the demo: sign in as admin@alnoor.example, press G then N, type 'purchase dxb', ArrowDown, Enter. Type 500 in 'Set the next number' and press Ctrl+S. The preview shows PO-2026-00500. Press Alt+Y: History has no entry for the change (c11-en-history-no-next-number-change.jpg). Open Audit log: the row reads 'Changed / Numbering counter / (empty) / Next number: from 148 to 500' (c12-en-audit-log-counter-row.jpg; API in c-probe-auditlog.txt, with record null and recordRoute null). c-probe-next-audit2.txt: GET /api/audit/records/{sequenceId} lists no next-number change. For the codes: change 'Starts again' to Never and press Ctrl+S. The change line and History read 'Restarts 1 -> 0' (c09-en-history.jpg) and, as admin.ar@alnoor.example, 'إعادة البدء: من 1 إلى 0' (c07-ar-saved-change-line.jpg). In the database, audit.entries.changes = {"reset": {"new": 0, "old": 1}}, and numbering's rows have record_label NULL (0 of 83 sequence rows, 0 of 20 counter rows).
